errors.evidence: The description states that the x-axis has labels every other year ('през една година'). The image shows labels for every single year from 2012 to 2019.
The description states the value in 2019 is 'slightly over 22000'. The line in the plot for 2019 is clearly below 22000, at approximately 21,500.
The description fails to mention that the y-axis does not have a label or title specifying what the values represent. It only mentions the numerical range.

The description states that the units of the y-axis are in euros (EUR) as if this information is present on the axis itself. However, the y-axis is unlabeled. This information is derived from the figure's caption, not the visual elements of the axis.
The description states the starting value in 2012 is 'around 16000'. The plot shows the value is slightly below 16000, closer to 15,800.
